title: Shadow Market Data Bridge & Warmup Integrity Gate
activation_verdict_rationale: Data bridge, rolling buffer, and frozen feature adapters are fully implemented and verified. However, overall activation remains BLOCKED because live host contiguity is 810 bars (< 864 required), Linux cgroup runtime behavior has not been tested in live container, and operator authorization is NOT_GRANTED.

MARKET_DATA_BRIDGE_IMPLEMENTED.detail: ShadowMarketDataBridge implemented with atomic validation, monotonic continuity, gap detection, and bounded memory buffer.

HISTORICAL_SEED_PROVENANCE.detail: HistoricalSeedProvenance utility enforces strict cryptographic hashing, start/end boundaries, and explicit stream separation (HISTORICAL_SEED_WARMUP).

CONTIGUOUS_WARMUP_READY.detail: Host live capture reports contiguous_bars_count=810, which is below the 864 contiguous 5m bars required for 72h SMA. System remains in WARMUP_BUFFERING until 864 bars are accumulated or authorized seed is loaded.

FROZEN_FEATURE_PARITY.detail: FrozenFeatureAdapter achieves exact mathematical parity for SMA 288, SMA 576, SMA 864, ATR 14, anti-chase extension (<= 2.25%), and volatility band [0.015, 0.065].

ANALOGUE_LIBRARY_INTEGRITY.detail: AnalogueArtifactLoader cryptographically verifies historical_analogues.csv (SHA-256 c6ed5912524e176bde0e941a0d69fe8f0c4f121759036ef2caa7219c06526ff1); refuses default fallback if missing or tampered.

EXECUTION_CAUSALITY.detail: Fills execute strictly at next_bar_open with 30 bps roundtrip friction. Missing next-open price refuses fill; zero same-candle execution.

BOUNDED_MEMORY.detail: PersistentRollingBuffer enforces 1,000-candle capacity ceiling with oldest-candle eviction and atomic state persistence.

CHECKPOINT_RECOVERY.detail: State persistence and restart recovery verified; reload from disk restores buffer and re-verifies full hash-chain lineage.

LINUX_RUNTIME_VALIDATION.detail: Process RSS verified on Windows host (115.8 MB); Linux cgroup memory/CFS enforcement was not tested in a live container to preserve read-only host invariants.

OPERATOR_AUTHORIZATION.detail: Formal operator authorization signature has not yet been executed.
